en.title: oa in noapte (night)
en.summary: The diphthong oa is found in the Romanian word noapte.

sections.title: The group oa
paragraphs: The letters oa make the sound /o̯a/. Hear this sound in the word (oameni) /ˈno̯ap.te/, which means night. This letter combination makes one single gliding sound in Romanian.

sections.title: Pronouncing oa
paragraphs: Round your lips slightly for a brief start. Then open your mouth wide and relax your lips completely. Let your voice flow continuously from the back to the front. You can feel your jaw drop as the sound finishes.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters oa make the sound /o̯a/ in stressed syllables, as in (noapte) /ˈno̯ap.te/. They also make the sound /o̯a/ in the word (soare) /ˈso̯a.re/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pronounce each letter as two separate vowels like in boa. Do not say the vowel in boat. Glide smoothly from a quick round vowel into a clear open sound.
